title: Integral Shell Polytopes of Composition Algebras
summary: Integral systems in real composition algebras give rise to finite metric configurations whose geometry is linked to both regular polytopes and root-systems. In this work we investigate, to our knowledge for the first time in this form, the shell polytopes obtained by fixing the integral norm and taking the convex hull of the corresponding integral elements. The first shells recover the familiar root-polytopal configurations attached to the classical Hurwitz systems, while the Okubo algebra gives a quite different behaviour.
